how: We read the website of every Indianapolis wedding planner listed on Lazo (72 listings, 57 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: officiants, venues and a caterer that also sell coordination, a stationery designer, a DJ company, a national franchise page, and a planner whose site is mostly keyword text. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full, partial or day-of: what does each tier include in meetings and hours, and who is on site on the day?
Which venues around Indy have you worked this year, and how do you run a barn venue 40 minutes out with no in-house staff?
What is your weather plan for an outdoor ceremony here, where spring and fall can swing 30 degrees in a day?

picks.name: Weddings By Bretta
picks.blurb: Since 2012, Bretta's small team has worked with more than 9,000 couples across Indianapolis and Central Indiana as certified planners, coordinators and officiants, one of the few outfits that can plan the day and marry you on it. Coordination and planning packages are laid out on the site.

picks.name: Creating Joyful Moments | Event Planning & Design
picks.blurb: Chloe Jackson's planning and design team works Indianapolis and destinations, with the pitch that there are about 5,000 details in every wedding and they will sort out and execute every one. The site notes a Wedding Rule listing among the Top 25 planners in Indianapolis.

picks.name: Magical Moments Event Planning
picks.blurb: A mother-daughter, family-run and female-owned planning company led by Amanda Allaby, offering everything from full planning to day-of coordination for Indiana and destination weddings. The aim is for you to be fully present while the family handles the details behind the scenes.

picks.name: Royal Weddings Co.
picks.blurb: Audrey has over seven years in events and an Indiana University degree in Tourism, Conventions and Event Management. Royal Weddings Co. bundles wedding planning and day-of coordination with hair and makeup and a getting-ready space called the Stanley Space, an unusual combination for one booking.

picks.name: Plum & Poppy Weddings
picks.blurb: Founded by a Purdue and Culinary Institute of America graduate who was a chef in New York before opening Plum & Poppy nearly 15 years ago. Planning, design and coordination from Zionsville, with the primary wedding packages and their pricing listed on the site.

picks.name: Arbor & Bloom Events
picks.blurb: A boutique planner and designer with over 10 years in events, based in Indianapolis and serving Chicago, Louisville and Cincinnati. Arbor & Bloom publishes the investment for each package and lists its unavailable dates for 2026 and 2027, so you can check before you inquire.

picks.name: Blue Llama Events
picks.blurb: An Indianapolis and Chicago wedding and event planner that bills itself as your guide and advocate through planning, for couples who want the best event possible or simply do not enjoy planning. Blue Llama also announces a luxury wedding planning offering.

picks.name: A Moment In Time Event Co.
picks.blurb: Paige Kelsheimer founded A Moment In Time out of putting together parties for family and friends, and now runs a team in Whiteland that handles venue sourcing and selection and helps source every other vendor. The site walks through how the process begins.

picks.name: Diamond Soriee Event Planners
picks.blurb: Established in 1980 and grown from community affairs into full event design, planning and production, for weddings as well as social and corporate events. Diamond Soriee lists venue referral and selection among the services its planners provide, with packages designed per occasion.

picks.name: Nerdy Fox Rentals & Designs
picks.blurb: Primarily a decor rental company, started at the end of 2016 to help couples build affordable events that match their personality, with wedding coordination, event design and florals offered alongside. Nerdy Fox has two lead coordinators and stylists plus a delivery and setup crew, out of Greenwood.
